title_zh: Leisure time — 第38节可背诵讲义
body_en: Hobby clubs turn free time into skill. Photos, chess, dance, or planting all teach careful work. Set a small goal for this month and show your progress. Invite a classmate who feels lonely to join once. Free time is richer when shared kindly.
body_zh: 爱好社团把空闲变成技能。摄影、象棋、舞蹈或种植都教细心工作。为本月设一个小目标并展示进步。邀请一位感到孤单的同学参加一次。善意分享时，空闲更丰富。
